primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.primary: Owned complete EN OUP EPUB, A Guide to the Good Life: The Ancient Art of Stoic Joy, William B. Irvine, ISBN 9780195374612
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: content.opf; text/part0002.html; text/part0004.html; complete introduction, 22-chapter text, notes and index spine
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Bibliographic metadata and substantial full chapter files distinguish this edition from a summary. Read-only access.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: text/part0007.html Introduction opening; part0010.html ch2 virtue/tranquility passage; part0011.html ch3 opening; part0019.html ch9 duty; part0020.html ch10 opening friendship advice
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Grand goal plus strategy; virtue remains linked to tranquility; four complementary Roman sources; shared life and selective friendship.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: text/part0013.html ch4 opening hedonic adaptation, two fathers, picnic objection, regret response and last-occurrence conclusion
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Original examples and qualifications: periodic contemplation rather than constant anxiety; first father also grieves, with less regret.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: text/part0014.html ch5 trichotomy, impulse qualms, tennis/internal goals, aspiring novelist and closing confession; part0015.html ch6 past/future distinction; part0016.html ch7 opening and pleasures; part0017.html ch8 bedtime examples
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Internal goals are explicitly Irvine’s reconstructive addition. Novelist submissions and residual sting are in the text. Past/present fatalism does not excuse abandoning future action. Review examples are Seneca’s.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: text/part0021.html ch11 insult responses, correction exception and political-correctness conclusion; part0022.html ch12 grief, retrospective visualization, reason and counseling qualification; part0023.html ch13 shipwreck, protection/correction and apology
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Author’s controversial claim is actually reported, with its voice separated from the account’s narrow qualification. Involuntary grief, reason’s limitations and counseling are not silently erased.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: text/part0024.html ch14 banquet opening; part0025.html ch15 simple pleasures/luxury; part0026.html ch16 Seneca/Musonius exile consolations and transition to old age; part0027.html ch17 opening; part0032.html ch21 evolutionary justification; part0033.html ch22 opening, rowing/other-self passage and full closing doubts/invitation
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Actual banquet price, luxury dependence, portable virtue, author’s evolutionary rejustification, sequential practice, rowing competition and explicitly uncertain ending.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.primary: Owned RU MIF edition, Радость жизни, ISBN 9785001461937
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: OEBPS/Text/info.xhtml; OEBPS/Text/pre.xhtml, scientific editor Stanislav Naranovich’s complete preface
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Read the whole editor’s preface directly; he disputes overstated Roman tranquility emphasis and affirms practical value. This is a separate voice from Irvine.

contentJudgment: A coherent, engaging concise account of Irvine’s practical Stoicism. It keeps virtue/social duty alongside tranquility, preserves original cases, identifies his modern additions, and reaches the actual qualified ending. No material factual reversal, fabricated incident or RU/EN meaning shift found.
materialLimitations: Targeted primary-text verification of represented arguments and examples, not continuous reading or certification of the entire 22-chapter book, omitted chapter-20 polemics, every ancient quotation or note.
RU condensation was compared with English primary meaning. Full Russian published translation was not collated; its edition page and complete editor preface were checked.
Verdict covers only the hashed revised collector package. Root HTML at inspection still had 112 old pairs; publisher must integrate the approved revision.
No new clinical-efficacy certification or repeated browser/device matrix; author’s philosophy is not approved as treatment.
